text:
Inflation-Adjusted Gold Price
Compare monthly gold observations in nominal and constant dollars.
The highest inflation-adjusted observation is
$5,353
in 2026-08 dollars (Feb 2026). The highest nominal observation in the matched sample is $5,222 (Feb 2026). The latest matched month is Aug 2026: $4,563 nominal and $4,563 inflation-adjusted.
Sources and methodology
. These are monthly samples, not daily or intraday records.
Show nominal price too
Real = monthly nominal fixing × CPI-U for
2026-08
÷ CPI-U for the observation month. Months without matching CPI data are omitted.
Why adjust for inflation?
A price in 1980 dollars and a price in 2026 dollars aren't comparable — the dollar buys far less today.
Converting each available month to
2026-08
dollars (using the BLS CPI-U index) puts six decades on one
honest scale, and shows gold's real purchasing power rather than just its headline number.
